name: 31523 · Brunswick, GA
findings: ZIP 31523 (Brunswick) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 31523 (Brunswick) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 31523 (Brunswick) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.
